## collection_date
**16 run(s)** — rule `che18-PRJNA357594-collection_date` — 10.1186/s12864-018-4513-4  
*Additional file 1 (12864_2018_4513_MOESM1_ESM.xlsx), sheet SupplementaryTable3, footnote*

> Mapping-statistics table naming all 16 sequenced samples, with the scheme footnoted: "Sample names show the name of inbred followed by type of treatment (B = mock, Fg = fungal inoculation), sample collection 1 day or 2 days post inoculation, and EXPERIMENTAL YEAR 2004 OR 2006". The 16 names are B73 and CO441 x B and Fg x 1d and 2d x 04 and 06. Every run's GEO title carries the same code verbatim (GSM2429847: B73Fg2d04), so the supplement supplies the key and the archive supplies the join; the code is in neither runinfo nor the BioSample attributes, which carry only line, treatment and days post inoculation and therefore give eight combinations for sixteen samples. Supplementary Table 2 additionally gives the inoculation windows (CO441 Aug 4-6 2004, B73 Aug 24-26 2004, CO441 July 28-30 2006, B73 Aug 14-16 2006), which would support month precision for three of the four groups; CO441's 2006 window closes on 30 July so 1-2 dpi straddles two months, and all sixteen are recorded at year precision instead.
